intent: Design studies of existing hero and eight swords, before runtime integration
commonSwordPrompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE redesigned pixel-art sword as a standalone transparent PNG, with no other weapons, panels, text, labels, border, background or ground shadow. Input 1 is the existing weapon-family gallery: use ONLY the identified sword as the identity/design reference, not as a source of realistic materials or intricate ornament. Input 2 is the accepted pixel camp direction: use it for the restrained warm/cool palette and 2D sprite feel. Preserve the specified sword's recognizable silhouette and color identity, while simplifying it for a Java top-down 2D action RPG. Premium deliberately constructed pixel art with unmistakable square pixel clusters, crisp stepped contours, sparse clean highlights, around 3 or 4 flat value bands per material, a selective dark outline. An enlarged presentation of a carefully drawn approximately 64 to 96 logical-pixel-long item sprite, using a consistent visible pixel unit; no tiny arbitrary 16x20 constraint. It must read as a distinct useful sword at small equipment size. No photorealistic materials, smooth painted gradients, airbrush, PBR metal, microtexture, elaborate filigree, clouds, bloom haze, floating particles, extra detached ornaments, plastic 3D rendering or blurry antialiased outline. Avoid merely applying a mosaic filter to the previous design. Keep a consistent 45-degree diagonal: pommel at lower-left, blade tip at upper-right. Center the entire sword including pommel and tip in a square canvas with generous transparent margin. Keep the sword fully intact as one connected silhouette. Alpha outside the sprite, not a painted checkerboard. No cast shadows or external glow. Draw at high enough output resolution to show the square pixel blocks clearly. Exactly one sword only.

hero.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redesign the existing hero in Input 1 into one cohesive premium pixel-art six-pose character sheet for a 2D top-down action RPG. Input 1 is the exact identity and six-pose arrangement reference, not the rendering-style target. Input 2 is the user's accepted camp pixel-art direction. Preserve brown tousled hair, red scarf with a short trailing end, navy tunic, cream sleeves, brown cross-body strap and belt, brown gloves and boots, youthful adventurer identity. Reduce tiny buckles, cloth micro-wrinkles, leather grain, shiny metal and realistic shading. No sword, shield or weapon attached to any pose; empty hands are needed for a separate weapon layer. Use clear deliberately placed visible square-pixel clusters and clean stepped contours, 3 or 4 flat value bands per material, consistent dark selective outlines and sparse highlights. Think of finely crafted 2D pixel sprites around 48 to 72 logical pixels tall, enlarged cleanly with visible square blocks, not a painting filtered into blocks. Medium-small adventurer proportions around 3.5 to 4 heads tall, not a huge-headed baby or realistic six-head anatomy. Make head direction, separated hands and feet, scarf and boots legible at small gameplay size. ALL six poses are exactly the same design, scale, volume, palette, pixel size and overhead camera angle. Arrange an evenly spaced 3-column by 2-row sheet on actual transparency. Upper row left to right: front-facing idle, back-facing idle, right-facing idle. Lower row left to right: front-facing walking pose, back-facing walking pose, right-facing walking pose. Six total full-body figures, one per equal cell; consistent foot baseline within each row and ample clear gaps. Walking poses have a modest step and opposite arm swing, no combat pose, no floating pose. Keep scarf accessory consistent in all views. Wide landscape sheet. No text, no labels, no grid lines, no scene, no inset heads, no seventh figure, no shadows, no glow, no checkerboard painted into the background, no blur or anti-aliased painted edges. Output a transparent PNG with only six pixel characters. This is a design sheet, not an invitation to make a highly detailed 3D-looking illustration.

swords.name: 흑철검
swords.detail: Target: BLACKIRON BASIC, upper row second weapon of gallery. Broad heavy straight dark iron blade with a squared shoulder and a modest pointed tip, dark blue-gray central plane, one clear pale edge highlight, short practical crossguard and brown/black wrapped grip. One small dull blue inset at guard is enough. No golden star cage, no multiple spikes, no blue electric aura. Basic forged weapon with strong broad silhouette; not awakened yet.

swords.name: 봉인된 성검
swords.detail: Target: SEALED HOLY SWORD, upper row first weapon of gallery. Ivory/silver straight double-edged blade, a simple muted brass crossguard and brown grip, compact diamond pommel. Preserve visible sealed identity with two broad dark iron binding bands or a clearly simplified diagonal chain across blade. Only a small warm gold inset at guard. Restrained old sacred weapon, no spread wings, no halo, no elaborate floral filigree. Make bindings part of the sword silhouette, no loose disconnected links.

swords.name: 혈월검
swords.detail: Target: BLOODMOON BASIC, upper row third weapon of gallery. A single elegant curved crimson blade that sweeps into a moonlike pointed tip, burgundy shadow plane, one coral-red edge highlight, small dark-brass crescent guard with ONE ruby-red center, dark wrapped grip. Keep a clear curved saber silhouette distinct from the straight swords. Remove ornate filigree, excessive spikes and multiple gemstones. No aura, blood splatter or floating red particles. Basic unawakened version.

swords.name: 천공검
swords.detail: Target: SKYFALL BASIC, upper row fourth weapon of gallery. Long slender straight cool blue blade, compact tapering pointed tip, simple small symmetric crossguard, one small cyan inset, dark navy wrapped grip and a compact pommel. Keep airy precise slender silhouette, not a spear, trident or staff. Muted silver/blue with very limited old-gold trim. No giant star guard, surrounding rings or long gold tendrils. Basic unawakened version; reserve purple and dramatic lightning shape for awakening.

swords.name: 깨어난 성검
swords.detail: Target: AWAKENED HOLY SWORD, lower row first weapon of gallery. Preserve the ivory/gold sacred straight-blade family. The seal is gone. Bright clean ivory blade with a single warm gold central stripe, slightly longer and more decisive tip than basic holy sword, a compact gold wing-shaped guard formed by only TWO broad wing shapes, single warm pale-gold center gem and brown grip. Clear elegant awakened silhouette without layers of small feathers, starbursts or lace. No bindings now, no huge bloom or halo. Warm heroic premium pixel design.

swords.name: 심연의 흑철검
swords.detail: Target: AWAKENED BLACKIRON, lower row second weapon of gallery. Same heavy dark-iron family as the basic broad straight blade, but the upper third widens into ONE angular shoulder near a sharply cut point. One single clean cyan/blue fissure runs along the dark blade's center, contained inside the silhouette. Compact strengthened geometric crossguard and dark leather grip. Blue edge highlight, very restrained brass connector. Do not cover it in teeth, gold filigree or multiple branching spikes. Strong mineral-forged shape, not a chainsaw. No aura outside the silhouette.

swords.name: 만월의 혈월검
swords.detail: Target: AWAKENED BLOODMOON, lower row third weapon of gallery. Preserve the elegant curved crimson blade, now a slightly fuller crescent with a clear hooked upper tip. ONE open circular dark-brass moon guard surrounding a single red center gem, with no extra rings, small restrained side crescents integrated into the guard at most. Rich burgundy shadow and clear scarlet edge, dark grip and compact red pommel. Read as an awakened crescent sword, no giant decorative thorns, no many gemstones, no lace, no blood particles, no glow outside sprite.

swords.name: 뇌명의 천공검
swords.detail: Target: AWAKENED SKYFALL, lower row fourth weapon of gallery. Preserve long slender sword silhouette, dark navy grip and compact symmetric guard. Blade has a controlled lightning geometry: ONE sharp angular split or zigzag notch near the pointed upper third. Cool cyan center with restrained violet outer plane and two narrow bright edge bands. Guard becomes a simple paired lightning-wing silhouette with ONE small violet inset, no surrounding astrolabe rings or multiple long curling spurs. Airy precise sword, not a spear or staff. No lightning arcs outside the blade, no bloom cloud.

followupSwordStyle.appliesTo: All swords except the first generated sword_blackiron
followupSwordStyle.promptAppendix: Input 3 is the already redesigned BLACKIRON basic pixel sword, used strictly as the pixel-rendering style reference. Match its deliberately simplified pixel clusters, dark selective outline, restrained material shading and overall amount of detail, while retaining the target sword's own shape and color. Do not copy the broad blackiron silhouette into the other weapon families.
